name: admintem
description: 菜单 + 按钮级权限的一体化后台管理模板

scripts.db:reset: docker compose down -v && docker compose up -d --build
scripts.test:docs: node admintem-docs/tests/check-doc-images.cjs && node admintem-docs/tests/check-tokens.cjs && node admintem-docs/tests/check-perm-keys.cjs && node admintem-docs/tests/check-permission-doc-consistency.cjs && node admintem-docs/tests/gen-role-endpoint-matrix.cjs --check
scripts.test:desktop: npm --prefix admintem-vue run lint && npm --prefix admintem-vue test && npm --prefix admintem-vue run build
scripts.test:mobile: npm --prefix admintem-mobile test && npm --prefix admintem-mobile run build
